chunks: With this chain, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abi al-Jarud, from Abi Burdah, who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prayed with us, then turned away hurriedly until he placed his hand on the door of the mosque, then he called out in a loud voice: 'O people! Whoever has believed with his tongue but has not made it sincere in his heart, do not pursue the defects of the believers. Indeed, whoever pursues the defects of the believers, Allah will pursue his defect, and whoever Allah pursues his defect, He will disgrace him, even if he is inside the depth of his house.'

key_terms.جَوْفِ بَیْتِهِ: inside the depth/interior of his house

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of exposing the defects of believers according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Thawab al-Amal*, the Prophet’s hurried departure after prayer underscores the urgency of guarding against *ghibah* (backbiting) and *tattus* (scrutinizing faults). Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the spiritual consequence of insincerity, where Allah’s exposure of one’s own *awrah* serves as a divine retribution for exposing others, a concept deeply rooted in Shia ethical teachings on social privacy.
